references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square with the Rectangle tool from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Under sewing ticked (first type, Density Medium), every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
